text: Anyone free to cover saturday's collection? 5th, 9.30am at the hall. Need someone there for the lorry drop
I can help what time do I need to be there
9.30 till about 12, sorting after the drop
Ok I will be there
I can do 9.30 to 12. Got a site visit after lunch
Ok good
Shop stocktake saturday morning. Can come after 2 if the loading's still going
We'll see. Might be done by then
Going to bed soon. Faisal can you confirm with the hall tmrw? Number's in the pinned msg
Ya will do
omg is this sat?? 😭📚 i have finals prep all weekend sry. cant do the morning
i can maybe do 12-2 though?? 🤞 if u still need someone after the drop 📦 will check my schedule tmrw
Called the hall. Confirmed for sat 9.30, they'll unlock the side gate for the lorry
Lorry is supposed to come at 9 so they should be there before us
Is the side gate the one by the bank or the other one
The one by the bank. Other one is still locked since the flood
ok checked schedule i think 12-2 is confirmed!! lecture got moved
Good. Whoever's doing the drop, make sure someone's at the gate before 9
Loading at the shop goes till about 1 on sat, my boy's driving the van. I'll be there around 2
Stocktake can wait till sunday
Did anyone pick up the bags of rice from the Tesco on Jalan Ipoh? Ibrahim said it was left at the back
No. I'm at a client now, can ask Ibrahim later
Ok. He said after 5
Ibrahim says the rice is in the back room already. He says don't worry
Oh good
Anyone coming to the sorting bit after the drop or just the drop? I'm bringing the big trolley
Both. Will stay till done if it's not too late
Can someone bring tape. Last time we ran out
i got tape!! bringing the packing one from my flat
Night. Keep the gloves in the blue box, not the trolley
Ok night
ugh cant sleep anyone else still up. finals prep
ok going to bed 😴 cant do study 2 more hrs
morning!! slept like a rock lorry still at 9?
Driver texted me. Same guy as last month, Pak Samad. Says 9 but could be early
Do we need the scales or are they still in the hall
Customer asking about christmas hampers again. Told him after new year
Scales are in the hall cupboard. Key is with Ibrahim
exam is on the 9th 😭📚 study group at the library after 3 if anyone wants. im so behind
Anyone seen my glasses case? Think I left it at the hall on Wed
Not in the blue box. Maybe on the table by the urn
Found it. It was in my bag
Shop closed yet Tan? Lorry driver wants to know if the hall has a turning spot
So far Saturday: Faisal 9.30-12, Lily from 9.30, Jasmine 12-2, Tan after 2 if loading's done. Nobody at the gate at 8.55 though. Need someone there before the lorry
Can't do 8.55, I'm at the shop till 1. Faisal you're earliest?
Ya I'll be at the gate 8.50. Lily want a lift?
Grab is fine thank you. I will be there 9.15
Lorry driver just texted, leaving at 8.30 not 9 🙃
Nurul you there? Lorry is 8.30 now
I'll tell Ibrahim to open the side gate for 8.20 then
